trait.name: Animated
entries: Si  object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 mètres and can hover. Si  object is securely attached to a surface or larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0.
When the animated object drops to 0touché points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remainingdgts carries over to its original object form.
The DM might rule that a specific objects slam attack inflicts slashing or piercingdgts based on its form.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}16 ({@dégât 2d12 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts.
